@web-ts-toolkit/oidc-vault-dpop-client: browser-only DPoP client for
@web-ts-toolkit/express-oidc-vault vault flows (body + cookie transports).
Vanilla TS, no framework, no default export. Full guide: README.md.

Install: pnpm add @web-ts-toolkit/oidc-vault-dpop-client
(jose + idb ride as dependencies; no separate install needed.)

Imports (named root only):
  import { createOidcVaultDpopSession, fetchWithDpop } from
    '@web-ts-toolkit/oidc-vault-dpop-client';
Also root-exported: getOrCreateDpopKey, createDpopProof, DpopNonceCache,
createDeviceFingerprint, fingerprintJsSignalSource, OidcVaultDpopClientError,
plus DpopKey/Scope, DpopAccessToken, DpopFetchContext/Options/Api,
OidcVaultDpopSession/Options, DeviceFingerprint types.

Workflow 1 — vault session lifecycle:
  session = createOidcVaultDpopSession({ backendOrigin, basePath,
    sessionTransport: 'body' | 'cookie' });  // basePath = exact mount
  login(returnTo?) -> exchange(code) -> getAccessToken/refresh -> logout.
  login/exchange always credentials:include; refresh/logout body=omit+sessionId,
  cookie=include+{} (never sessionId in cookie JSON). Vault nonce failures are
  HTTP 400 OIDC_VAULT_USE_DPOP_NONCE with one retry. Key loss (DPOP_KEY_LOST)
  requires fresh login; never fall back to Bearer or ephemeral keys.
  Access JWT: memory only. Body handle: tab-local sessionStorage. Cookie
  handle: backend HttpOnly. Keys: IndexedDB scoped
  [frontendOrigin, backendOrigin, basePath]. Cookie mode also needs Web Locks
  + BroadcastChannel. Cross-site HTTPS needs transactionCookie sameSite none,
  trustedOrigins, credentialed CORS exposing DPoP-Nonce/WWW-Authenticate.

Workflow 2 — bound API fetch:
  fetchWithDpop({ session, apis: [{ origin, replayNamespace }] }, url, opts?).
  Owns Authorization/DPoP, redirect:error, no-store; fresh proof+ath per
  attempt. API nonce failures are 401 use_dpop_nonce with one retry; only
  invalid_token triggers one refresh. GET/HEAD/OPTIONS retryable; mutations
  single-attempt unless retry:'idempotent' with a server idempotency contract.

Workflow 3 — optional recognition (opt-in change detection, never PoP):
  fingerprint = createDeviceFingerprint(async () => signal | undefined);
  Pass { fingerprint } to session options. 403
  OIDC_VAULT_FINGERPRINT_REAUTH_REQUIRED -> clear auth, fresh login.

Limits: Chromium 151 + Firefox 153 evidenced (same-site loopback); Safari/
WebKit uncertified; third-party-cookie policy is deployment-specific.
Backend wire tables stay authoritative in express-oidc-vault README.
Live example: apps/oidc-vault-dpop-example (both transports + browsers).
